jr-note: This exists specifically for http://zampanio.net/webring.htm, which apparently is too old to query an https json file. I hope I don't forget to keep this up to date as well.
message: It is absolutely incredible how many modern internet security principles this guide violates: https://irt.org/articles/js085/  Do not follow it. I almost did and then realized I could just host json and then you don't need to trust any random script I tell you to inject into your page. All we really need is a centralized source of truth and a tiny javascript snippet we can copy and paste (after reading it like responsible wastes)
